explanation.text: The Logic: Rho measures the sensitivity of the option price to a one-percentage-point change in the risk-free rate or cost of funding (workbook page 78). It is expressed as Rho = Change in Option Price / Change in Interest Rate. The Trap: The other Greeks measure different sensitivities — Delta is sensitivity to the underlying's price, Gamma is the rate of change of Delta, and Theta is sensitivity to time. Rho is specifically about interest rates. Note: Rho captures how option premiums respond to changes in the funding/risk-free rate used in pricing models.
